missing_sections._note: Section heading not rendered at all by the legacy page (value null in JSON).

empty_sections._note: Section rendered but contained no rows/items (value [] in JSON).

text_conservation._note: Every non-empty HTML text node was compared (as a multiset) against the JSON values plus static template labels. Entries here mean data was lost.

legacy_count_vs_parsed_rows._note: The legacy page sets section counters via setText(); compared to parsed rows.
